_comment: OPTIONAL. Without data/accounts.json the suite registers one throwaway DemoBlaze account per worker by itself.
To pin real accounts instead: copy to data/accounts.json (gitignored) and fill in credentials.
CI restores that file from the TEST_ACCOUNTS_JSON secret when it is set — see .github/workflows/playwright.yml.
ORDER MATTERS: workers pick by INDEX. The pool needs at least (shards x workers) entries — see src/fixtures/account-pool.ts.
